# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **eCat captures 9.8% of $87.1M total business** — trailing 12 months, the platform handles 3,983 orders at a $2,147 average value, 42% higher than the all-channel average of $1,511. [→ §commerce]
2. **90% of order volume remains off-platform** — with 57,645 all-channel orders vs. 3,983 on eCat in the trailing 12 months, rep enablement represents the largest single lever for growing eCat's contribution. [→ §commerce]
3. **Top buyers show 27–60% eCat penetration** — among the highest-volume accounts with total business data available, eCat captures between one-quarter and two-thirds of their ordering, leaving meaningful upside even at the most-engaged accounts. [→ §commerce]
4. **Quote orders average $4,818 vs. $2,147 overall** — the 108 quotes submitted in the trailing 12 months carry more than double the value of confirmed orders, suggesting high-value transactions flow through the quoting workflow effectively. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Expanding eCat usage from 10% to 20% of total business GMV could represent an estimated $8.7M in additional platform-attributed revenue annually, primarily by activating reps who currently place zero orders on the platform [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
